reviews.text: Nucadamia is an amazing color! The color looks fantastic on beige skin tones. Lightly warmly pinky orange and it smells like a gummy! Color stays on very well and it’s very moisturizing and not sticky. Got the Miffy version with the little blur fudge pot with it, and the pot is waaay lighter on beige skin so it works better as a cheek blush.
reviews.zh: Nucadamia 呢個色真係超靚！配米色肌膚一流。帶少少暖調粉橙色，仲有陣軟糖味！顯色度好好，又好保濕唔黏。我買咗 Miffy 版本，附送細細個 blur fudge pot，喺米色肌上面個 pot 嘅色淺好多，用嚟做胭脂反而更夾。

reviews.text:
I like the finish, and overall it wears nicely on the lips, but I expected a longer-lasting result from a tint. In reality, you still need to reapply after drinks/food.

But!! I ordered three shades, and two of them were Bare Marron and Earl Grey Lychee. They were supposed to be different… but do you see any difference? Because I don’t. I applied both on clean lips, over cushion foundation.
reviews.zh:
我鍾意個妝效，整體上嚟講喺嘴唇上嘅表現都唔錯，但我對一支 tint 嘅持久度期望再高啲。事實上你飲完嘢食完嘢之後都仲要再補。

但！！我買咗三個色，其中兩個係 Bare Marron 同 Earl Grey Lychee。本應係唔同嘅色……但你睇得出有分別嗎？因為我睇唔出。我喺素唇上面，同埋喺 cushion 粉底上面都試過搽呢兩支。

reviews.text:
I bought this tint last time and it was soooo beautiful… that’s why I decided to get another shade. But I realized the company changed the formula. The new formula is different from the old one… it dries quickly on the lips, while the old one didn’t. The color is very pretty and suits me, I really liked it, but I wish I had bought this shade in the old formula. The new formula feels irritating to my lips, while the old one was amazing, making my lips soft without any irritation. My skin is sensitive and gets irritated easily, and the new formula dries out my lips… I really hope they bring back the old formula. If you found my review helpful, please give it a like.
#BringBackTheOldFormula
reviews.zh:
上次買過呢支 tint 真係靚到爆……所以我就決定再入手多一個色。但我發現品牌換咗配方。新配方同舊配方完全唔同……喺嘴唇上會好快乾，舊嗰支就唔會。個色好靚好啱我，我自己真係好鍾意，但可惜我冇買到呢個色嘅舊配方。新配方搽喺我嘴唇上有刺痛感，舊嗰支完全唔會，仲令到我嘴唇軟軟哋唔會敏感。我皮膚敏感、易敏感，新配方會令到我嘴唇爆擦……真係好希望佢哋出返舊配方。如果你覺得我嘅評論有幫助，俾個 like 啦。
#出返舊配方

reviews.text: I don't know why I cannot capture in pictures what Bare Grape looks like IRL, it looks nothing like the lip pic swatch on this site. I wish it did look like what my phone captures it as! The second swatch is what it looks like to me on my lips in person. It actually looks like a dark pink mauve after one light application. I was expecting/wanting something to look like a natural pink MLBB color, this one was not it. That being said, I do love how moisturizing and non-sticky this gloss is and will try other shades. Like every other lip product, it needs to be re-applied every time you have something to eat.
reviews.zh: 我唔知點解影唔到 Bare Grape 實際上嘴嘅效果，佢同呢個網站上面嘅唇部試色完全唔似。我好希望佢真係似我電話影出嚟嗰個色！第二張試色就係我自己親自上嘴睇到嘅效果。輕輕搽一層其實已經似深粉紅色嘅 mauve。我原本期望／想要嘅係自然粉紅 MLBB 嘅效果，呢支完全唔係。儘管如此，我真係好鍾意佢嘅保濕度同唔黏笠，會再試其他色。同其他唇部產品一樣，每次食完嘢都要再補。

reviews.text:
FYI I have Muted Autumn Warm Toned skin. Iykyk

COLOR 🩷🩷🩷🩷🤍
Pulls off like natural lip color with a hint of muted pink. Looks very different depending on the lighting. It can look like light peach in bright lighting to mauve in darker lighting. You'd need to completely concealer off your own lip color to achieve the color seen in product photos. Overtime, it becomes more dark beige on your lips and loses the pink-tone.

MEDIUM GLOSS 🩷🩷🩷🤍🤍
Not the most high-gloss product out there. Give a very even shine in one coat. And not too sticky!

APPLICATOR 🩷🩷🤍🤍🤍
The applicator is on the smaller side. It's good for lip corners but, hard to cover the entire lip with one dip.

CASE DESIGN 🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷
Love the case design!
reviews.zh:
提示，我係 Muted Autumn Warm Toned 膚色。Iykyk

COLOR 🩷🩷🩷🩷🤍
搽上去似自己唇色加少少 muted 粉紅。唔同光線下效果差好遠，光猛嘅環境睇落似淺 peach，暗啲嘅環境就似 mauve。要先用遮瑕完全遮住自己唇色，先可以做出產品相嗰個效果。時間耐咗，喺嘴唇上會變得偏深 beige，粉紅調會消失。

MEDIUM GLOSS 🩷🩷🩷🤍🤍
唔算係最 high-gloss 嘅產品。搽一層已經可以做到好平均嘅光澤。而且唔會太黏！

APPLICATOR 🩷🩷🤍🤍🤍
掃頭偏細。對唇角位好就，但要一次過沾滿成唇就好難。

CASE DESIGN 🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷
好鍾意個盒嘅設計！

reviews.text: This shade is absolutely beautiful — I love it so much! The soft pink color has such a fresh and elegant vibe, it's perfect for everyday wear but also has that special something that makes it stand out. The packaging is also stunning — sleek, modern, and super chic with that transparent pink design. It’s definitely one of those products that not only looks great on but feels luxurious to use as well.
reviews.zh: 呢個色真係靚到爆——我超級鍾意！柔和嘅粉紅色帶出清新又優雅嘅感覺，日常用一流，但又帶有少少特別嘅元素令佢更突出。包裝都好靚——型格、時尚、超 chic 嘅透明粉紅設計。絕對係其中一款上嘴好睇，用落又有奢華感嘅產品。

reviews.text: Honestly, I was not expecting too much from this, because the previous formula felt a bit drying on my lips, but this beat the ball out of the park! First of all, it almost feels like wearing a very moisturizing lipstick, but the lipstick barely budges! I love the "23" color, as the neutral-ish color is not too intense, and is perfect for everyday use, regardless of whether you apply foundation or not. The only concern I have, is that if your lips is cracking one day or is otherwise sore, you may feel some unfomfortable stinging when applying. However, when the skin barrier on your lips are intact, you don't feel any uncomfortable feelings. Also, this smells wonderful! (Just to be clear, for those who are sensitive to smells, the fragrance goes away a short while after application)
reviews.zh: 老實講，我本身對佢冇太大期望，因為上一代配方搽喺我嘴唇上有少少乾，但呢支真係超水準！首先，佢幾乎好似搽緊一支超保濕嘅唇膏，但支「唇膏」極之持久！我好鍾意「23」呢個色，屬於中性色調，唔會太重，無論有冇搽粉底都好適合日常用。我唯一嘅憂慮係，如果有一日嘴唇爆裂或者有其他唔舒服，搽嘅時候可能會有少少刺痛感。不過，嘴唇屏障完好嘅話，就唔會有任何唔舒服嘅感覺。佢嘅味道仲好正！（對味道敏感嘅人先講清楚，香味喺搽完一段短時間後就會散）

reviews.text:
This new formulation is much thinner, I honestly like the thicker feel of the old formula better. The smell is a similar sweet smell to the original, but not the same. However this isn’t as drying as the old formula, which is a plus. 

The reason for the 3 stars is this particular color, Peach Peach Me suffers from the red/pink oxidation that happens with a lot of k-beauty lip products. It only stays the nice peach color advertised in the photos for about 10 seconds, then oxidizes into a garish deep reddish-pink fuchsia color. 

Incredibly, incredibly disappointing. I swatched it on a napkin in the picture to show the true deep saturated color that shows up, that looks nothing like the lovely advertised peach color.
reviews.zh:
呢個新配方薄咗好多，我個人比較鍾意舊配方嗰種厚身嘅質感。味道同原版一樣係甜味，但唔完全一樣。不過佢冇舊配方咁乾，呢一點係加分。

俾 3 星係因為 Peach Peach Me 呢個色，氧化之後會變成紅／粉紅色——好多 k-beauty 唇部產品都有呢個問題。佢只會維持到相入面廣告嗰種靚 peach 色大概 10 秒，然後就會氧化成一種好刺眼嘅深紅偏粉紫紅色。

超級、超級失望。我喺紙巾上面試色，影埋相俾大家睇真正變成嘅深色同飽和色，呢個色完全同廣告嗰種靚 peach 色唔似樣。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
